user.title: Select the distribution system operator
user.description: Select the DSO shown on your distribution bill.

tariff.title: Select a tariff group
tariff.description: Your tariff group is shown on the contract or bill. Local time is correct for modern AMI meters.

data_description.day_hours: Only relevant to ENEA G12; verify the hours on your contract or meter.

energy.title: Select the energy price source
energy.description: Default-seller prices are checked against the official URE workbook every 12 hours. If you switched seller or offer, enter the gross prices from your contract.

data.external_statistics: Create costs for external consumption statistics

data_description.external_statistics: Enable only when the meter exposes statistics without entities (for example imported TAURON AMIplus hourly data). Regular entity-based meters do not need this.

custom_prices.title: Enter gross energy prices
custom_prices.description: Enter active-energy prices including VAT and excise duty in PLN/kWh. Distribution is added separately.

external_statistics.title: Map consumption statistics to zones
external_statistics.description: Select a cumulative energy statistic (kWh) for each zone. The integration creates the corresponding gross cost statistic in PLN for use as the cost statistic in the Energy dashboard.

error.invalid_hours: Invalid hours. Use 6-13,15-22; intervals must not overlap.
error.duplicate_statistics: Each tariff zone must use a different consumption statistic.

init.title: Energy price settings
init.description: Change the price source, ENEA G12 hours, or meter clock behavior. URE prices are checked every 12 hours.
